cases.finding: First-match origin checks and noncanonical digest flags could conceal restrictive provenance or shared content.
cases.resolution: Group all origins by canonical digest algorithm plus bytes, preserve unchanged sets and check every changed attribution. Reject unencodable disclosed knowledge/decision text before successful cell, envelope, frame or capsule identities can collapse to an empty encoding.
cases.remaining: Authenticate producer-derived origins and propagate them through a negotiated wire profile.

cases.finding: Sequential numeric receipts admitted another hypothesis and did not identify exact evidence, predecessor history or all state after oversized reset text.
cases.resolution: Refuse foreign hypotheses, preserve complete bounded evidence/state/history commitments, add a bounded lifetime source-once numerical profile, and expose explicit supervisor modes. Exact raw sensor, class label and unbinned detector score remain immutable per consumed source. Resets preserve source inventory and refused steps or runs export no successful prefix.
cases.remaining: Qualify calibration and test-supermartingale assumptions, establish authenticated physical source identity and temporal dependence handling, and integrate source-once accounting with retained supervision. Declared digests and deterministic receipts do not establish custody, independence or effects.

cases.finding: Native cross-session clock validation had no operator input/report path or retained multi-camera motion consumer.
cases.resolution: Expose strict frozen-session CLI validation and a shared original-query replay owner. The retained-motion v2 adapter independently pins the original query, replays every native candidate under the parent work account, binds actual rig/image geometry and exact retained source/clock generations, and maps full original capture intervals using every candidate before native temporal association.
cases.remaining: Authenticate clock-query observation custody/associations and calibrations, qualify live deployment behavior, and separately authorize physical clock activation or durable calibration adoption. Replayed hypothesis hulls neither synchronize cameras nor certify continuous coverage.
